statement: I_AB is a covariance/Fisher matrix and is positive semidefinite; after removing exact vertical nulls it should be positive definite on horizontal leakage modes.
why_it_matters: This gives the sign of the local quadratic penalty without inventing a sign by hand.

statement: Choose the leakage metric by parent pullback G_AB := I_AB on the horizontal bath-coordinate chart.
why_it_matters: This makes C_AB align with G_AB by construction, not by an extra fitted isotropy axiom.

statement: If G_AB has already been fixed by another parent block, keep C_AB=I_AB and carry C_perp=I_AB-2u_1 T_eff^-1 G_AB as an anisotropy residual.
why_it_matters: This prevents hiding anisotropy in notation and gives a testable residual vector.

statement: mu_H^2 >= T_eff lambda_min(G_H^-1/2 I_H G_H^-1/2) - R_domain - R_source_slope.
why_it_matters: The previous 3695/3696 mass-gap law now has a candidate parent origin for its positive Hessian.
